blocks.text: Yeh nazariya Lynn Margulis ne pesh kiya. Is ke mutabiq bare prokaryotes ne chhote prokaryotes ko nigal (engulf) liya. Bare cells ne chhote prokaryotes ko hazam (digest) nahin kiya; balke chhote prokaryotes bare cells ke andar rehne lage aur waqt ke saath organelles (cell ke andar ke chhote hisse) ban gaye.

Bare aur chhote prokaryotes ne aisa symbiotic rishta (dono ke faide wala saath) banaya jis mein dono cells ko faida hua. Kuch chhote prokaryotes aerobic respiration (oxygen se tawanai banana) kar sakte the. Woh sirf apne liye nahin balke bare cell ke liye bhi tawanai (energy) dete the. Yahi eukaryotic cells ke mitochondria ban gaye. Kuch doosre chhote cells sooraj ki roshni se khuraak bana sakte the aur yeh khuraak bare cell ke saath baant'te the. Yeh eukaryotic cells ke chloroplasts ban gaye. Isi tarah flagella (cell ki dum jaisi cheez jo tairne mein madad deti hai) shayad spirochetes jaise prokaryotes ko nigalne se aaye.

Endosymbiosis se bane eukaryotic cells taqatwar aur kar-aamad (efficient) the. Is taqat aur kar-aamadgi ki wajah se un mein nayi khasiyatein aa sakin, maslan multicellularity (bohat se cells wala jism), cell specialization (cells ka alag alag kaam ke liye khaas ban jana) aur bara size. Aaj duniya mein janwaron, paudon aur fungi (phaphoond) ki jo shandar rangarangi (diversity) hai, us ki kunji yahi cells the.

blocks.title: Membrane Invagination Theory
blocks.text: Ek aur nazariya, “Membrane Invagination Theory”, bhi eukaryotes ka evolution samjhata hai. Is ke mutabiq prokaryotic cell ki cell membrane cytoplasm ke andar ki taraf mur gayi (invaginate hui). Is se prokaryotic cell ke andar membrane wale kuch structures bane, jin mein nucleus aur endoplasmic reticulum shamil hain. Is tarah eukaryotic cell bana.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke box ka aakhri jumla kehta hai ke is se “prokaryotic cell” bana. Yeh ghalat hai: andar mudi hui membranes se nucleus aur ER ban jane ke baad cell eukaryotic ho jata hai, is liye sahi “eukaryotic cell” hai.

blocks.title: Evidence for the endosymbiotic theory (Endosymbiotic theory ke saboot)
blocks.text:
• Mitochondria (aur chloroplasts) ka size prokaryotic cells jitna hai.
• Mitochondria (aur chloroplasts) ka apna DNA hai, jo prokaryotes ki tarah ek gol (circular) chromosome ki shakal mein hai.
• Mitochondria (aur chloroplasts) prokaryotes ki tarah binary fission (do hisson mein bat jana) se barhte hain; jabke eukaryotic cells mitosis se taqseem hote hain.
• Mitochondria (aur chloroplasts) ki membrane ki banawat eukaryotic membranes ke bajaye prokaryotic membranes se zyada milti hai.

blocks.alt: Neeli kinari aur peele cytoplasm wale gol cells ka silsila. Ancestor Prokaryote (beech mein DNA); teer se Infolding of plasma membrane; phir Nucleus aur Endoplasmic reticulum wala cell; phir Engulfing of aerobic prokaryote; phir Mitochondrion wala Ancestral heterotrophic eukaryote. Nigalne wale cell se doosra teer oopar: mitochondrion wala cell Engulfing of photosynthetic prokaryote, phir Chloroplast wala Ancestral photosynthetic eukaryote.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tarteeb yaad rakhein: pehle membrane andar mur kar nucleus aur ER banati hai, phir aerobic bacterium nigla jata hai jo mitochondrion banta hai. Yahan raasta do hisson mein bat'ta hai: aik line heterotrophic eukaryote (sirf mitochondria, jaise janwar aur phaphoond) banti hai, aur doosri line photosynthetic bacterium bhi nigal kar chloroplast wala photosynthetic eukaryote (paude aur algae) banti hai.

blocks.prompt: Do saboot dein ke mitochondria kabhi alag rehne wale bacteria (prokaryotes) the.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: mitochondria ka size prokaryotes jitna hai; un ka apna gol (circular) DNA hai; woh binary fission se barhte hain; un ki membranes prokaryotic membranes jaisi hain.

items: Lynn Margulis: bare prokaryotes ne chhote prokaryotes nigle jo organelles ban gaye; aerobic wale mitochondria, roshni se khuraak banane wale chloroplasts.
Flagella shayad spirochetes jaise prokaryotes se aaye; eukaryotic cells ki taqat se multicellularity aur diversity aayi.
Saboot: size, apna gol DNA, binary fission, prokaryote jaisi membranes. Doosra nazariya: membrane invagination (nucleus aur ER bane).
